purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: demography lecture; population vocabulary (人口/中央/平均/区) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 都市の人口は、中央に集まりがちです。
lines.en: Urban populations tend to gather in the center.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 一つの区に、何人くらいいるんですか?
lines.en: About how many live in one ward?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 中央の区は、人口が特に多いです。
lines.en: Central wards have especially large populations.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 平均すると、どのくらいですか?
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 平均で、一つの区に数万人います。
lines.en: On average, tens of thousands per ward.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 中央以外の区は、少ないんですか?
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、平均より少ない区もあります。
lines.en: Yes, some wards are below average.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 都市の人口の偏りが、よく分かりました。
lines.en: I understand the urban population imbalance well.
lines.style: satisfied adult student voice, soft warm realization throughout
